Product information
With the help of the control rings, you can perform a simple yet reliable check of the displacement between calibration intervals. For a reference measurement, the handhled hardness testing device is positioned centrally on the control ring and pressed evenly until the pressure plate lies flat on the control ring. If the hardness tester displays the correct hardness of the corresponding control ring during the reference measurement, it operates reliably within the standard-compliant displacement for hardness range. 
The control rings are available for checks of the displacement for 20, 40, 60 and 80 Shore/Asker and are calibrated by us according to DAkkS standards.
Video
Key Features 
Daily secure measurement results 
With the help of the control ring, you regularly check the displacement of your handheld hardness testing device between calibration intervals. This ensures that contaminations to the indenter and hardness tester are quickly detected, and you always receive accurate measurement results.

DAkkS accredited Service
DAkkS Accredited Service 
Since 1996, Bareiss Prüfgerätebau GmbH has been recognized as a DAkkS-accredited calibration laboratory, standing for the highest quality and precision. Our calibrations comply with international standards according to DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025:2018, ensuring reliable and intentionally comparable measurement results. 
Take advantage of our service offerings: 
DAkkS-accredited laboratory since 1996 – Calibrations meeting the highest requirements and global standards.  
Calibration reminders – We automatically remind you of your next calibration.  
Service packages – Accredited calibration including maintenance and repair at a fixed price. Everything from a single source. 
Trust Bareiss for reliable calibrations and accurate measurement results.
Benefit from our experience as a manufacturer and accredited calibration laboratory.
